speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are early for a man who was among players. Sit. The soft side is cut, and the crust is not on your trencher.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in the afternoon, Mistress. The king goes up without me. I would rather not hear his name over bread.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is a penny, and it is a full thumb short of the notch. I measured it against the board before you were in the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was short yesterday and it is short today. I am not surprised, and I am not buying a second penny's worth to make it honest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence covers the board. Honesty is not an extra loaf. How is the jaw, in words a landlady can use?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hole has closed over. It is tender. This is the last day of the tenderness, if I am any judge of my own face, and I may be a bad one. I am not well. I am not trying a crust.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the soft side is right. I kept the brown edge for the yard, for whoever is hungry and has two sides of a mouth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You came in with ink on the finger. One word, by the look of the smear. I hope it was a cheap word.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was one word, and it belongs to a man who found a wait I had not written. I have not promised him another. That is as cheap as a word gets.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A wait. In a kitchen, I hope. Kitchens are made of waits, and of people shouting for things that are already on the fire.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A kitchen in a hurry. You have the right of it, Alse, and I will not tell you the plot of it over your own table. The hurry is the part I needed. The rest can stay at Shoreditch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. I do not go to playhouses, and I do not have them brought to my board in a sack. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. The soft side takes no argument from the left.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has been on the Holinshed since you went out. I did not shift him. The book was shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. A shut book can bear a cat, and an open one has survived him too.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The hall candle is the sixpence, and it is not lit at noon. If you write after you have eaten, you write by the window. I am not starting the firing for a margin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The window will do. I am not going back for the king, and I am not lighting a candle to avoid him.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I warm the broth as well, for the side that is still tender?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Warm it. Yesterday's quiet was a Sunday. Today is a Tuesday, and Tuesday is honest about what it still is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Honest is the broth. The parish can keep the king. I have heard no name from you, and I do not want one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not have one. Whoever plays this afternoon is his own affair. My affair is a word in a margin, and it is already written.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will take the crusts out to the step. They will not sit on the board and tempt a man who has refused them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take them. I have refused them in company already. I can refuse them in a house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. When you are done, the table is yours until the light goes. After that, upstairs is your candle, and the hall is mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the division. I will keep it. And I will not call myself mended before tomorrow has had a look at me.
